book: Johannis Althusius, Civilis conversatio (1611), a Latin treatise on civil conduct in one volume of two books: Liber I, De conversatione communi, and Liber II, De Ethica propria. Each book has its own numbered chapters, preceded by a dedication and a chapter index, and the text ends with FINIS.
